The root of the name, "shamil," means "complete" or "all-inclusive." This aspect of the name resonates with the Islamic concept of being Universe-centered and God-conscious, as embodied by the famous Hadith, "The whole world is but a vessel: Allah fills it, and the one who is blessed in filling it before Allah is benevolent."
